description: This file defines the application's routing logic using Flutter's Navigator 2.0 system. It includes implementation of custom RouteInformationParser and RouterDelegate, managing authentication gating and navigation between sign-in and main tabs pages.

classes.name: _AppRoutePath
classes.description: Represents a route's path in the application's navigation stack, encapsulating the location string.

classes.name: _AppRouteInformationParser
classes.description: Parses route information from route data to internal route path representation and vice versa.

classes.name: _AppRouterDelegate
classes.description: Handles the current navigation state and builds the Navigator widget based on authentication state.

classes.name: _SignInPage
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the sign-in page UI.

classes.name: _MainTabsPage
classes.description: A stateful widget that manages and displays bottom tab navigation for main app sections.

classes.name: _TabInfo
classes.description: Data class for representing information about each tab item, including title, icon, and content.

methods.name: buildRouter
methods.description: Builds and returns the application's RouterConfig with custom delegate and parser.
